info.title: FitEpic API
info.description: The FitEpic API provides endpoints for user authentication and AI-powered workout parsing. Authenticate via **User/Register** or **User/SignIn** to obtain a JWT bearer token, then supply it in the `Authorization: Bearer {token}` header for all protected endpoints.

200.description: OK

post.summary: Send a gym membership invite by email. Owner or Admin only.
post.description:
Inviting at `Admin` requires the gym Owner specifically. Inviting at `Athlete`
or `Coach` requires Owner or Admin.
            
The invitee is identified by email; the server resolves it to an athlete internally.
**The response is identical whether or not the email matches a registered athlete** —
unknown emails are silently dropped server-side and produce the same 202 Accepted body
as a successful invite. This is deliberate (see requirements §6.2): any observable
difference would let the endpoint act as an account-enumeration oracle. The UI must
not attempt to surface "user not found" feedback; show the typed email and trust the
server.
            
Other failure modes (gym not found, insufficient role, duplicate pending invite,
invitee-already-member) still return their respective error codes. Those describe
state the calling admin already has access to via the gym member list and pending-
invite list, so they do not constitute new information leakage.
            
Requires a valid `Authorization: Bearer {token}` header.

get.summary: List workouts owned by a gym. Coach, Admin, or Owner only.
get.description:
Returns the workout templates available for scheduling within the gym. Coaches/Admins/
Owner use this to pick existing workouts when programming for a group.
            
**2026-05-20: athlete-tier callers receive 403.** Athletes have no use case for browsing
a gym's workout template library — they only consume workouts via scheduled instances
pushed to their training groups, surfaced through `GET /api/mobile/scheduledworkouts`.
(Previously this endpoint accepted any gym member.)
            
Pass `since` for delta sync — returns every row (including tombstones and archived
rows) with `UpdatedAt > since`. The include flags are ignored on delta pulls.
            
Omit `since` for a bootstrap pull — by default returns live, non-archived rows only.
Pass `includeArchived=true` and/or `includeDeleted=true` for a backdoor admin
view that surfaces archived/soft-deleted history. The mobile sync layer should call this
with `includeArchived=true` so its local cache retains archived rows for resolving
historical scheduled-workout references.
            
Requires a valid `Authorization: Bearer {token}` header.

parameters.description: Delta-sync watermark. Omit for a bootstrap pull.

parameters.description: When `true`, includes rows with `IsArchived = true` in bootstrap pulls. Ignored on delta pulls. Defaults to `false`.

parameters.name: includeDeleted

get.summary: List the scheduled workouts an athlete has on the gym's schedule.
get.description:
**v14 (2026-05-22).** Gym-scoped athlete-pivoted oversight surface. Returns the rows the
target athlete is scheduled for **within this gym** — group-targeted rows where the athlete
is a current member of the row's training group (mid-flight rule applied). Each row's
per-athlete state (Status / ScoreResult / Notes / Duration / ExerciseLogs) is merged from
the athlete's own `ScheduledGroupWorkoutAthleteResult` when present; rows the athlete
hasn't engaged with yet carry their template defaults (`Status = Pending`, etc.).
            
**Personal-scheduled rows are deliberately excluded** — they are athlete-private under the
v14 scoping model. Gym staff have no read access to workouts that never entered a gym
context. The coach surface is the gym's view of athlete X's coaching, not X's whole life.
            
Authorization: caller must be Coach, Admin, or Owner of the gym. The target athlete must
hold a non-deleted Athlete-tier `GymMembership` in the gym (collapsed to 404 to avoid
disclosing gym/membership existence to callers who shouldn't know about it).
            
Pass `since` for delta-style consumption (returns tombstones). Pass `from`/
`to` for a date range. Both can combine with paging.
            
Requires a valid `Authorization: Bearer {token}` header.

parameters.description: The athlete whose schedule is being viewed.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 100, capped at 500.

get.description:
Returns the caller's own profile (timezone, streak start date, etc.). The profile row is
auto-created on first read with default values, so callers never see a 404 for a missing
row. Used by mobile on cold start and pull-to-refresh to converge on the server's
source-of-truth state across devices.
            
Possible `error.code` values:
<list type="bullet"><item><description>`UNAUTHENTICATED` (401)</description></item></list>

put.summary: Update the authenticated athlete's mobile self-profile (partial update).
put.description:
Partial-update semantics per field: omit a property to leave it unchanged, send `null`
to clear it, send a value to set it. Mobile pushes the device's IANA timezone identifier
server-side so that Quote of the Day rotation can resolve "today" against the athlete's
local date, and pushes the athlete-chosen streak / day-count start date.
            
Side effect: the athlete's profile `UpdatedAt` is bumped, so the next
`GET /api/mobile/quotes/today/state?since=...` call returns data (usually the same
QuoteOfTheDay the client already has, an idempotent upsert on the local cache).
            
Possible `error.code` values:
<list type="bullet"><item><description>`UNAUTHENTICATED` (401)</description></item><item><description>`INVALID_TIMEZONE` (400) — supplied `timezone` is not a recognized IANA identifier.</description></item><item><description>`VALIDATION_FAILED` (400) — `error.details["streakAndDayCountStartDate"]` when the supplied start date is in the future.</description></item></list>

post.summary: Sync a batch of scheduled workout create, update, or delete operations from the mobile client's outbox.
post.description:
Accepts an array of sync operations and applies them server-side using Last-Write-Wins conflict
resolution. All accepted operations are written atomically in a single database transaction.
            
Operations where the server record is newer return `ConflictResolved` — the mobile client
should re-pull those records on the next delta pull.
            
Two scheduling targets are supported:
<list type="bullet"><item><description>Self-scheduling (`athleteId == currentAthlete`, `trainingGroupId == null`) — always permitted.</description></item><item><description>Group scheduling (`trainingGroupId` set) — the requesting athlete must be Coach, Admin, or Owner of the group's gym.</description></item></list>
Cross-athlete scheduling via peer connections (the legacy `ProgramWorkouts` flow) is no longer
supported and returns `403 Forbidden`. Add the athlete to a training group instead.
            
The server always overrides the `isLocked` field — the mobile payload value is ignored.
For locked records, only log fields (`status`, `scoreResult`, `notes`,
`exerciseLogs`) may be updated; template fields are preserved.
            
Requires a valid `Authorization: Bearer {token}` header.

This endpoint supports the mobile client's Delta Pull mechanism. Pass the greatest
`UpdatedAt` timestamp received during a previous sync as since
to receive only records modified after that point. Soft-deleted records
(`IsDeleted = true`) are included in the response so the client can tombstone them locally.

catalog from the beginning. Loop through all pages until `Page == TotalPages` before
advancing the local sync watermark and allowing app navigation.

`(scheduledWorkoutId, targetAthleteId)` by soft-delete (`IsDeleted = true` on the
result row and every non-deleted child `WorkoutExerciseLog`). The athlete's personal
feed / dashboard reverts to the template default (Status = Pending, no score, no logs) on
the next read because the merge layer no longer finds a live result row at that pair.
The row stays in the database as a tombstone so delta consumers can pick up the change.
            
**Idempotent.** Returns 204 whether or not a live row existed at the supplied pair. Coach
UIs can fire-and-forget without checking existence first.
            
**No mid-flight check on delete.** Unlike the POST endpoint, this verb intentionally
skips the target-athlete-membership check — a coach must be able to reverse a stale
result row even after the athlete has left the training group (otherwise the athlete is
permanently stuck with a wrong record). See `readmes/gym-ownership-requirements.md`
§13.15 (Q64) for the product rationale.
            
Authorization: caller is Coach/Admin/Owner of the gym; cannot target themselves (use the
regular sync endpoint to clear your own row, not this one). Targeting self → 403.
            
Requires a valid `Authorization: Bearer {token}` header.

Drives the day-streak pill, the activity dot-line, and the days-worked-out pill on the
web dashboard. All date math is resolved in the athlete's profile timezone.
get.description:
The response carries a per-day timeline (`recentDays`, newest-first, up to 90 entries
with leading empty days trimmed) plus pre-computed `currentStreak`, `isActiveStreak`,
`daysActive`, and `daysInWindow`. The web client owns layout (snake rows, dot styling)
and visibility rules (pills hide when their counts hit the documented thresholds).
            
The streak walk uses a one-day grace (a completion yesterday with no completion today still
counts) and stops at `StreakAndDayCountStartDate` inclusively when that floor is set on
the athlete's profile. The days-worked-out window is `[StreakAndDayCountStartDate, today]`
when set, otherwise a 30-day rolling window ending today.
            
Response is sent with `Cache-Control: no-store` — the API has a global no-store
policy on every response so clients never serve stale state (athletes and coaches both
expect immediate reflection of completions, reschedules, etc.).
            
Possible `error.code` values on non-2xx responses (see `WebAppErrorCode` for the full enumeration):
<list type="bullet"><item><description>`PROFILE_TIMEZONE_REQUIRED` (400) — athlete has not set a profile timezone.</description></item><item><description>`INVALID_TIMEZONE` (400) — stored timezone is not recognized on the server.</description></item><item><description>`PROFILE_NOT_FOUND` (404) — athlete profile record is missing.</description></item><item><description>`UNAUTHENTICATED` (401) — token missing or invalid.</description></item></list>

get.summary:
42-cell calendar grid + workout cards for a single calendar month, all resolved in the
athlete's profile timezone. Drives the web app's calendar-view schedule page.
get.description:
The server computes the visible 6-row × 7-column grid for year /
month. The window starts on the Sunday on or before the 1st of the
month and runs 42 days. Indicator booleans and hydrated workout cards cover every date
in the window — including leading and trailing days from adjacent months — so a single
request hydrates both the grid and the user's selected-day list. Dismissed rows are
excluded. Group-targeted rows are merged with this athlete's per-athlete completion
state.
            
Response is sent with `Cache-Control: no-store` — the API has a global no-store
policy on every response so clients never serve stale state.
            
Possible `error.code` values on non-2xx responses (see `WebAppErrorCode` for the full enumeration):
<list type="bullet"><item><description>`VALIDATION_FAILED` (400) — year or month is missing or not an integer.</description></item><item><description>`MONTH_OUT_OF_RANGE` (400) — month is outside 1..12 or year is below 1900. Future months are allowed (athletes plan ahead).</description></item><item><description>`PROFILE_TIMEZONE_REQUIRED` (400) — athlete has not set a profile timezone.</description></item><item><description>`INVALID_TIMEZONE` (400) — stored timezone is not recognized on the server.</description></item><item><description>`PROFILE_NOT_FOUND` (404) — athlete profile record is missing.</description></item><item><description>`UNAUTHENTICATED` (401) — token missing or invalid.</description></item></list>

get.summary:
Five relative-date buckets — yesterday / today / tomorrow / future / past — with
cursor-paged past and future. Drives the web app's list-view schedule page.
get.description:
All bucket boundaries are computed in the athlete's profile timezone. Today / tomorrow /
yesterday are unbounded (at most a handful of rows each) and are always populated
regardless of which cursors are supplied. Past and future are bounded by
pastLimit / futureLimit (default 50, server-capped
at 200).
            
Cursors are opaque base64url strings. Clients must treat them as black boxes — never
parse, mutate, or compare. Pass pastCursor /
futureCursor back unchanged on subsequent requests. The
`PastNextCursor` / `FutureNextCursor` response fields are null when the
corresponding bucket has been fully drained.
            
Group-targeted rows are merged with this athlete's per-athlete completion state.
Dismissed rows are excluded.
            
Response is sent with `Cache-Control: no-store` per the global API policy.
            
Possible `error.code` values on non-2xx responses (see `WebAppErrorCode` for the full enumeration):
<list type="bullet"><item><description>`VALIDATION_FAILED` (400) — pastLimit or futureLimit is less than 1.</description></item><item><description>`INVALID_CURSOR` (400) — a supplied cursor failed to decode or did not match the expected shape.</description></item><item><description>`PROFILE_TIMEZONE_REQUIRED` (400) — athlete has not set a profile timezone.</description></item><item><description>`INVALID_TIMEZONE` (400) — stored timezone is not recognized on the server.</description></item><item><description>`PROFILE_NOT_FOUND` (404) — athlete profile record is missing.</description></item><item><description>`UNAUTHENTICATED` (401) — token missing or invalid.</description></item></list>

parameters.name: pastCursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a prior response's `pastNextCursor`. Omit to fetch from the start of the past bucket.

parameters.name: futureCursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a prior response's `futureNextCursor`. Omit to fetch from the start of the future bucket.

200.description: Returns the five-bucket list payload.

400.description: Validation failure, invalid cursor, or profile-timezone failure.

Sorted by FitEpic.Api.Models.WebApp.Response.DashboardWorkoutCardResponse.ScheduledDate ascending, then by name.

DateOnlyNullableJsonOptional.description:
Wire-format wrapper for request DTOs that distinguishes "property absent from JSON"
(FitEpic.Api.Models.Json.JsonOptional`1.HasValue = `false`) from "property present, value `null`"
(FitEpic.Api.Models.Json.JsonOptional`1.HasValue = `true`, FitEpic.Api.Models.Json.JsonOptional`1.Value = `null`). Used to express
tri-state partial-update semantics: omit = leave unchanged; `null` = clear; value = set.

date.description: Calendar date in the athlete's profile timezone.

state.description: Rollup state for this date — see FitEpic.Services.ServiceModels.WebApp.DayActivityState.

targetAthleteId.description:
The athlete whose per-athlete result row is being written. Must be a current
(non-deleted) `TrainingGroupMembership` member of the group, and the group's
`ScheduledDate` must be on or after that membership's `AssignedAt`
(mid-flight rule). The caller cannot be the target — coaches who want to log
their own row go through the regular sync endpoint, not this one.

status.description:
Result status for the target athlete (typically `Completed`, but `InProgress`
/ `Pending` are accepted for partial logs). `Dismissed` is not valid for
group rows and is rejected with 400.

scoreResult.description:
Free-form score string, format determined by the parent workout's `ScoreType`.
Null when the athlete has no score recorded. When non-null, FitEpic.Api.Models.Request.GroupResultOnBehalfRequest.Status must be
`Completed` (the same invariant enforced by the regular sync endpoint).

notes.description: Optional coach notes captured on the athlete's behalf. Null when absent.

duration.description: Actual time the athlete spent on the workout. Null when no duration is recorded.

exerciseLogs.description:
Per-exercise log rows. Sent in full on every write — incoming logs are upserted by Id;
logs present on the existing result row but absent from this payload are soft-deleted.

GroupResultOnBehalfRequest.description:
Body for the coach-on-behalf write into a group-scheduled workout's per-athlete result table.
Posted to `POST /api/gyms/{gymId}/groups/{groupId}/scheduled-workouts/{scheduledWorkoutId}/results`.
Carries the target athlete plus the log-shaped fields the caller (Coach/Admin/Owner of the
gym) is recording on behalf of that athlete. The route segments identify the row; the body
identifies the recipient and the values being recorded. See
`readmes/gym-ownership-requirements.md` §13.14 for the v14 scoping rationale.

id.description: Unique identifier of the per-athlete result row.

athleteId.description: The athlete this result belongs to (the target of the on-behalf write).

scoreResult.description:
Score string when present, format dictated by the parent workout's `ScoreType`.
Null when no score was recorded.

notes.description: Coach-entered notes on the athlete's behalf. Null when no note was set.

duration.description: Actual time the athlete spent on the workout. Null when no duration was recorded.

completedAt.description:
Timestamp when the result transitioned to `Completed`. Null when status is not
Completed. Once stamped, preserved across subsequent edits while still Completed.

createdAt.description: When this result row was first inserted.

updatedAt.description: When this result row was last updated (server-stamped on every write).

exerciseLogs.description: Per-exercise log entries belonging to this result row.

GroupResultOnBehalfResponse.description:
Returned from the coach-on-behalf write into a group-scheduled workout's per-athlete result
table (`POST /api/gyms/{gymId}/groups/{groupId}/scheduled-workouts/{scheduledWorkoutId}/results`).
Carries the persisted state of the target athlete's result row so the caller can update the
UI without a follow-up read. See `readmes/gym-ownership-requirements.md` §13.14.

Null when the athlete hasn't set a display name — clients should render a placeholder
(e.g., the email prefix or "Athlete") rather than the raw `AthleteId`.

athleteEmail.description:
Email of the referenced athlete, projected from `AspNetUsers.Email` at query time.
Always present (every account has an email). Useful for staff to disambiguate members
with the same display name. Subject to the same mild staleness caveat as
FitEpic.Api.Models.Response.GymMembershipResponse.AthleteDisplayName.

Wire representation of an athlete's membership in a gym. The gym Owner does NOT have a
membership row — ownership is identified by `Gym.OwnerAthleteId`. Includes soft-deleted rows.

isGymOwner.description: Whether the authenticated athlete has gym ownership enabled.

id.description: Unique gym identifier (server-generated UUID).

ownerAthleteId.description:
Athlete ID of the gym's Owner. Maps to `AspNetUsers.Id` system-wide.

**Visibility (2026-05-20):** populated for Coach/Admin/Owner callers. **Null for
athlete-tier callers** — athletes do not need to know the gym's owner identity, and
withholding this field tightens the gym detail surface for athletes who legitimately
shouldn't see other athletes' identifiers via the gym list.

ownerDisplayName.description:
Display name of the gym's Owner, projected from `AspNetUsers.Name` at query time.
Null when the Owner has not set a display name, OR — under the per-caller redaction
applied to FitEpic.Api.Models.Response.GymResponse.OwnerAthleteId — when the caller is an athlete-tier member of
the gym (staff get the full payload). The schedule-tab "Programmed by" chip uses this
to resolve owner-programmed rows without an extra lookup, since the Owner does not
carry a `GymMembership` row to look up against.
Same mild-staleness caveat as `GymMembership.AthleteDisplayName` — not bumped when
the underlying name changes, so cached projections briefly trail the truth.

description.description: Free-text description. Null if not set.
description.example: A small-group strength and conditioning gym in central Texas.

gymCode.description:
6-character alphanumeric code shared out-of-band with prospective members for the join-request flow.
May be rotated via `POST /api/gyms/{id}/regenerate-code`.

**Visibility (2026-05-20):** populated for Coach/Admin/Owner callers only. **Null for
athlete-tier callers** — the gym code is the invite credential and must not leak to
athletes who have no legitimate use for it. Athlete-tier UI should not surface a "share
gym code" affordance.

updatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of last modification. Drives delta-sync comparisons.

isDeleted.description:
True when the gym has been soft-deleted. Mobile clients should treat such rows as
tombstones and clear their local copy.

GymResponse.description:
Wire representation of a gym. Includes soft-deleted rows so mobile clients can reconcile
local state on delta pulls.

id.description: The athlete's unique identifier (same as `ApplicationUser.Id`).

timezone.description: The persisted IANA timezone identifier; null when the athlete has not yet set one.

streakAndDayCountStartDate.description:
The date the athlete has chosen as the start of their streak / day-count tracking
history; null when not set (clients fall back to their existing default — typically
today minus 30 days).

Whether the athlete has opted in to gym ownership. Toggled via
`PUT /api/gyms/me/owner-flag` (which carries its own `GymsStillOwned`
validation when turning off). The mobile client reads this to drive gym-creation UI
affordances and to proactively short-circuit the `NotGymOwner` case before any
gym-creation attempt.

MobileAthleteSelfProfileResponse.description:
Response body for `GET` and `PUT /api/mobile/athletes/me/v1`. The shape is
forward-compatible — additional optional profile fields will be added over time.
Mobile clients should ignore unknown fields so server roll-outs that add new properties
don't break parsing.

year.description: The calendar year for this period.

month.description: The calendar month for this period (1–12).

daysInMonth.description:
Number of days in the full calendar month — independent of how far elapsed the
period is. Always 28..31.

daysElapsed.description:
Number of calendar days included in the aggregation window. Equals FitEpic.Api.Models.WebApp.Response.MonthlyStatsPeriodResponse.DaysInMonth
for any past month and for the previous-month period; for the current month it is the day
number of "today" in the athlete's profile timezone (1 on the first of the month).

workoutsCompleted.description: Count of completed, non-deleted scheduled workouts inside the window.

workoutsScheduled.description:
Count of non-deleted scheduled workouts inside the window regardless of status —
including Dismissed rows, matching the dashboard weekly card.

exercisesPerformed.description:
Sum across each completed workout of its parent workout's non-deleted exercise count.
A workout with 5 exercises completed twice contributes 10.

totalWeightLiftedLbs.description:
Total volume lifted across logged sets: `weight × reps` where `reps` parses
to a positive integer, otherwise just `weight`. Logs without a positive recorded
weight are excluded.

totalDurationMinutes.description:
Total effective workout time within the window, rounded up (ceiling) to the nearest
minute. Uses the same effective-duration rule as the weekly-stats card and the
duration-breakdown endpoint (logged duration → time-based score → prescribed duration).

workoutsWithDuration.description:
Count of completed workouts in the window that contributed a positive effective duration
(i.e., the resolver returned a positive `TimeSpan` for them).

daysWorkedOut.description:
Distinct count of `ScheduledDate` values among the completed workouts in the
window — i.e., how many separate calendar days the athlete worked out.

MonthlyStatsPeriodResponse.description: Aggregated stats for a single time window inside a month.

year.description: The calendar year the response describes.

month.description: The calendar month the response describes (1–12).

hasNextMonth.description:
`true` when the client can navigate forward — i.e., the requested month is strictly
            earlier than the athlete's current month in their profile timezone. `false` when the
            requested month is the current month.

current.description: Aggregates for the requested month, truncated to "today" for the current month.

previous.description:
Aggregates for the full previous month. Null when the previous month has no scheduled
workouts at all (the web client uses this signal to hide the comparison bars).

previousAtSameDay.description:
Aggregates for the previous month truncated to the same number of elapsed days as
FitEpic.Api.Models.WebApp.Response.MonthlyStatsResponse.Current. Null when the requested month is a past complete month, when
the current month has just begun, or when FitEpic.Api.Models.WebApp.Response.MonthlyStatsResponse.Previous is null.

MonthlyStatsResponse.description:
Aggregated stats for a single calendar month, plus the prior month and a "previous month
at the same day count" snapshot for paced comparisons. All date math is resolved in the
athlete's profile timezone.

id.description: The unique identifier of the athlete.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier; null when the athlete has not yet set one.

streakAndDayCountStartDate.description:
The date the athlete has chosen as the start of their streak / day-count tracking
history; null when not set.

isGymOwner.description:
Whether the athlete has opted in to gym ownership. Toggled via
`PUT /api/gyms/me/owner-flag` (which carries its own `GymsStillOwned`
validation when turning off). The web app reads this on app load to drive the
"Create gym" FAB visibility, the settings toggle's initial state, and proactive
handling of the `NotGymOwner` case before any gym-creation attempt.

MyAthleteProfileResponse.description:
The authenticated athlete's self-profile (Web App surface). Distinct from
`AthleteProfileResponse`, which represents a connected athlete's display
data on the Mobile surface.

items.description: The quotes on the requested page.

totalCount.description: Total number of user-added quotes for the caller.

hasMore.description:
WebApp-only convenience field: true when more pages remain after this one.
Mobile responses omit this field. Null when not populated by the surface that returned this object.

Paged list of the caller's user-added quotes. Returned by
`GET /api/mobile/quotes/mine` (no `HasMore`) and
`GET /api/webapp/quotes/mine/v1` (adds `HasMore`).

error.description: Human-readable description of why the parse request failed.
error.example: Unable to parse the provided workout text.

reason.description:
Machine-readable reason code indicating why parsing failed.
Use this to display a specific message to the athlete in the mobile app.

ParseWorkoutErrorResponse.description: Error response returned when a workout parse request cannot be fulfilled.

rawText.description: Raw workout text to parse. Can include exercise names, rep schemes, time domains, loading, and any other workout details.

ParseWorkoutRequest.description: Request body for parsing a free-form workout description.

name.description: The workout name, if one could be identified (e.g., "Fran", "Cindy"). Null if the workout is unnamed.

workoutType.description: The structural type of the workout. Common values: `AMRAP`, `ForTime`, `EMOM`, `Strength`, `Chipper`.

predictedScoreType.description:
The predicted score type for this workout. One of the `WorkoutScoreType` enum string values
(e.g., `TimeToComplete`, `RoundsAndReps`, `HeaviestLoad`). The mobile client parses
this directly via `Enum.Parse<WorkoutScoreType>()` — casing must match exactly.

originalText.description: The original workout text exactly as submitted by the caller.

instructions.description: Optional workout-level coaching notes or movement instructions extracted from the text. Null if none were found.

roundCount.description:
Number of prescribed rounds extracted from the workout text. Null for all workout types except
`Intervals`, or when no explicit round count was found in the text.

duration.description:
Overall workout duration extracted from the workout text (time cap or total prescribed work,
e.g. "20 min AMRAP" → 00:20:00). Null when no overall workout duration was identified —
typical for StraightSets, open ForTime with no cap, or workouts whose duration depends solely
on athlete pace.

exercises.description: Ordered list of exercises extracted from the workout, sorted by their position in the original text.

ParseWorkoutResponse.description: Structured representation of a workout parsed from raw text.

name.description: The exercise name as extracted directly from the raw workout text.

matchedExerciseName.description: The canonical exercise name from the standard exercise library if a match was found. Null if no match.

standardExerciseId.description:
The `Id` of the matched `StandardExercise` record (GUID string). Used by the mobile client
as the foreign key when saving a `WorkoutExercise`. Null if no match was found — never fabricated.

sets.description: Total number of sets prescribed for this exercise. Null if not specified in the workout text.

reps.description:
Rep count for each set. Contains a single value when all sets share equal reps (e.g., `[10]` for 3x10),
or one value per set for pyramid schemes (e.g., `[21, 15, 9]`). Null if reps are not prescribed.

targetWeight.description:
The prescribed load extracted from the raw workout text in lbs (e.g., `95.0` from "Thrusters 95lb").
Used by the mobile client to pre-populate `WorkoutExercise.TargetWeight`. Null when no load is specified.

duration.description:
The prescribed work interval formatted as `hh:mm:ss` (e.g., `"00:01:30"` for 1 min 30 sec).
Extracted by the AI from interval-based workout descriptions. Null for rep-based exercises.

targetDistance.description:
The prescribed distance value extracted from the workout text. Always paired with
FitEpic.Api.Models.Response.ParsedWorkoutExerciseResponse.TargetDistanceUnit. Null when no distance is specified.

targetDistanceUnit.description:
Unit for FitEpic.Api.Models.Response.ParsedWorkoutExerciseResponse.TargetDistance. One of `"Meters"`, `"Kilometers"`,
`"Miles"`, or `"Feet"`. Null when FitEpic.Api.Models.Response.ParsedWorkoutExerciseResponse.TargetDistance is null.

targetCalories.description:
The prescribed calorie target extracted from the workout text (e.g., `15` from "15 Cal Row").
Used by the mobile client to pre-populate `WorkoutExercise.TargetCalories`. Null when not specified.

perRoundMetric.description:
The per-round metric the AI detected for this exercise. One of `Weight`, `Duration`,
`Distance`, `Calories`, `Reps`, or `CustomValue`. Null when the AI did not
detect a per-round metric for this exercise.

measurementType.description:
The primary measurement the AI identified for logging this exercise. `None` means the AI
could not determine a measurement type — the athlete can select one in the mobile app before saving.

order.description: Zero-based position of this exercise within the workout sequence.

ParsedWorkoutExerciseResponse.description: A single exercise entry within a parsed workout.

isPinned.description: True when this quote is the athlete's currently-active pin.

forDate.description: The athlete-local date this selection applies to (resolved server-side from profile timezone).

updatedAt.description:
The greater of the athlete's profile `UpdatedAt` and their pin row's `UpdatedAt`.
Mobile passes this value back as the `since` cursor on the next state-sync.

QuoteOfTheDayResponse.description:
The caller's currently-displayed Quote of the Day. Returned by both the mobile sync
resource (`GET /api/mobile/quotes/today/state`) and the webapp dashboard
(`GET /api/webapp/quotes/today/v1`).

author.description: The quote's author. Null when the athlete did not specify one.

isSystem.description: True for seeded system quotes (read-only); false for user-added quotes.

isOwnedByMe.description: True when the caller is the athlete who created this quote — controls edit/delete affordances on the client.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp on this quote row.

QuoteResponse.description:
A single quote in the caller's visible pool (system seed quote OR a quote the caller
added themselves). Returned by the mobile and webapp Quote of the Day surfaces.

id.description: The unique identifier for this reaction.

workoutLogId.description: The ID of the workout log this reaction is on.

athleteId.description: The ID of the athlete who reacted.

athleteName.description: The display name of the athlete who reacted. Null if the athlete has no display name set, or for endpoints that do not populate this field (e.g. the toggle endpoint, since the caller already knows their own name).

type.description: The reaction type. One of `Fire`, `Strong`, `Fast`, `Clap`, or `Trophy`.

isDeleted.description: Whether this reaction has been soft-deleted (toggled off).

ReactionResponse.description: Represents a reaction on a completed workout.

email.description: The user's email address. Must be unique across all accounts.

name.description: The user's display name. Null if not provided — can be set or updated later.

password.description:
The user's password. Must meet ASP.NET Identity complexity requirements
(uppercase, lowercase, digit, and non-alphanumeric character).

RegisterRequest.description: Request body for registering a new user account.

todayDate.description: Today's calendar date in the athlete's profile timezone.

yesterday.description:
Cards scheduled for yesterday (FitEpic.Api.Models.WebApp.Response.ScheduleListResponse.TodayDate − 1). Ordered Pending before
Completed; within each, stable by date then by id.

today.description: Cards scheduled for today. Same ordering rule as FitEpic.Api.Models.WebApp.Response.ScheduleListResponse.Yesterday.

tomorrow.description:
Cards scheduled for tomorrow (FitEpic.Api.Models.WebApp.Response.ScheduleListResponse.TodayDate + 1). Same ordering rule as
FitEpic.Api.Models.WebApp.Response.ScheduleListResponse.Yesterday.

future.description:
Cards scheduled strictly after tomorrow, ascending by date then Pending before Completed
then by id. Bounded by the request's `futureLimit` (default 50, server-capped at 200).

past.description:
Cards scheduled strictly before yesterday, descending by date then Pending before
Completed then by id. Bounded by the request's `pastLimit` (default 50, server-capped
at 200).

pastNextCursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page of FitEpic.Api.Models.WebApp.Response.ScheduleListResponse.Past. Null when exhausted. Clients must treat this string as a black box — never parse, mutate, or compare it. Pass it back unchanged as the `pastCursor` query parameter on the next request.

futureNextCursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page of FitEpic.Api.Models.WebApp.Response.ScheduleListResponse.Future. Null when exhausted. Clients must treat this string as a black box — never parse, mutate, or compare it. Pass it back unchanged as the `futureCursor` query parameter on the next request.

ScheduleListResponse.description:
Response payload for `GET /api/webapp/schedule/list/v1`. Drives the web app's five
relative-date buckets (yesterday / today / tomorrow / future / past) with cursor-paged
past and future.

id.description: The mobile-generated UUID that uniquely identifies this scheduled workout.

workoutId.description: The ID of the workout template this scheduled workout is based on.

athleteId.description:
The athlete this workout is scheduled for. Set for personal-scheduling rows. Null when
FitEpic.Api.Models.Request.ScheduledWorkoutRequest.TrainingGroupId is set (group-targeted scheduling — every athlete in the
group sees the row). Exactly one of `AthleteId` / `TrainingGroupId` must be
non-null per row; sending neither (or both) is rejected.

trainingGroupId.description:
The training group this workout is scheduled for. Set by Coach/Admin/Owner when
programming for a group; the row becomes visible to every athlete in the group (with
the mid-flight rule applied per requirements §7.1). Null for personal scheduling
(in which case FitEpic.Api.Models.Request.ScheduledWorkoutRequest.AthleteId must be set). Group rows always come back
from the server with `IsLocked = true`.

programmedByAthleteId.description: The ID of the athlete who programmed this workout for another athlete. Null if self-programmed.

scheduledDate.description: The date the workout is scheduled to be performed.

status.description: The current completion status of this scheduled workout.

scoreType.description: How the workout result is measured and scored.

scoreResult.description: The athlete's recorded result for this workout (e.g., "14:32", "185"). Null if not yet logged.

notes.description: Optional notes from the athlete about their performance. Null if not provided.

isLocked.description:
Indicates whether this scheduled workout was programmed by a trainer and its template fields are
locked. The server always determines and overrides this value — mobile payload value is ignored.

duration.description:
Actual duration the athlete spent on this scheduled workout, as logged by the athlete.
Distinct from the parent workout's prescribed duration. Null when the athlete has not yet
logged a duration. The mobile client typically pre-fills this from the parent workout's
`Duration` when present and lets the athlete confirm or override before logging.

exerciseLogs.description: The individual exercise log entries capturing the athlete's actual performance.

createdAt.description: The UTC timestamp when this scheduled workout was first created on the mobile client.

updatedAt.description: The UTC timestamp of the most recent local modification. Used for Last-Write-Wins conflict resolution.

isDeleted.description: Whether this scheduled workout has been soft-deleted on the mobile client.

ScheduledWorkoutRequest.description: The scheduled workout payload sent as part of a batch sync request.

id.description: The unique identifier for this scheduled workout (mobile-generated UUID).

workoutId.description: The ID of the workout template this scheduled workout is based on.

athleteId.description:
The athlete this workout is scheduled for. Set for personal-scheduling rows. Null when
FitEpic.Api.Models.Response.ScheduledWorkoutResponse.TrainingGroupId is set (group-targeted scheduling — every athlete in the
group sees the row). Exactly one of `AthleteId` / `TrainingGroupId` is
non-null on every server-returned row.

programmedByAthleteId.description: The ID of the athlete who programmed this workout for another athlete. Null if self-programmed.

scheduledDate.description: The date the workout is scheduled to be performed.

status.description: The current completion status of this scheduled workout. Serialized as a string enum value.

scoreType.description: How the workout result is measured and scored. Serialized as a string enum value.

scoreResult.description: The athlete's recorded result for this workout (e.g., "14:32", "185"). Null if not yet logged.

notes.description: Optional notes from the athlete about their performance. Null if not provided.

isLocked.description:
`true` if this workout was programmed by a trainer and its template fields are locked.
            The athlete may only update log fields (`status`, `scoreResult`, `notes`,
            `exerciseLogs`) when this is `true`.

duration.description:
Actual duration the athlete spent on this scheduled workout, as logged by the athlete.
Distinct from the parent workout's prescribed duration. Null when the athlete has not yet
logged a duration.

exerciseLogs.description:
The individual exercise log entries capturing the athlete's actual performance.
Always present; may be empty if the athlete has not yet logged results.

createdAt.description: The UTC timestamp when this scheduled workout was first created.

updatedAt.description:
The UTC timestamp of the most recent server-side modification. Used by the mobile client as the
`since` cursor for subsequent delta pulls.

isDeleted.description:
`true` if this scheduled workout has been soft-deleted. The mobile client must remove
            this record from its local store when this field is `true`.

loggedCount.description:
Number of athlete-tier members of the workout's training group who have a non-deleted
`ScheduledGroupWorkoutAthleteResult` at `Status = Completed` for this row.
Populated **only** on responses from the per-group oversight endpoint
(`GET /api/gyms/{gymId}/groups/{groupId}/scheduled-workouts`); null on every other
endpoint (personal feed, mobile delta, etc.) because the metric only makes sense for
the gym schedule view. Coach/Admin/Owner participants are excluded from the count —
the metric is about athletes-being-coached, not staff who happen to train alongside.
Athletes who have left the group (no current membership) are also excluded even if
their completed result row still exists.

groupSize.description:
Number of current athlete-tier members of the workout's training group at the time of
the request. Same population rule as FitEpic.Api.Models.Response.ScheduledWorkoutResponse.LoggedCount: populated only on the
per-group oversight endpoint; null everywhere else. Staff (Coach/Admin/Owner) of the
gym are excluded — the denominator counts athletes only. The value is the same for
every row in a single response (it's a group-level metric, but echoed per row to keep
consumer-side logic simple).

ScheduledWorkoutResponse.description:
Represents a scheduled workout record returned by the delta pull endpoint. Includes soft-deleted
records and records programmed by a trainer so the mobile client can maintain a complete local view.

scheduledWorkoutId.description: The group-scheduled workout this list belongs to. Mirrors the route segment so consumers can disambiguate batched fetches.

athletes.description:
One entry per athlete in scope: current athlete-tier members of the training group (with
their result if logged, or null for "not logged") plus any athletes who logged the workout
but have since left the group (history-preserved, `IsCurrentMember = false`). The

instructions.description: Optional free-text instructions or notes for the workout. Null if not set.

rawText.description: The original raw text that was used to create this workout. Null if created manually.

workoutType.description:
The structural type of this workout (e.g., `Intervals`, `AMRAP`, `ForTime`).
Serialized as a string enum value.

scoreType.description: How the workout result is measured and scored. Serialized as a string enum value.

scoreLabel.description: Optional label describing the score (e.g., "Total Reps"). Null if not set.

roundCount.description: Number of prescribed rounds. Null for all workout types except `Intervals`.

duration.description:
Overall workout duration (time cap or total prescribed work). Null when no overall workout
duration is specified — typical for StraightSets, open ForTime with no cap, or workouts
whose duration depends solely on athlete pace. Mobile clients use this value to compute
metrics for completed scheduled workouts and must treat null as "no duration prescribed."

origin.description:
Indicates whether this workout was created for the athlete's own training (`Personal`)
or while programming for other athletes (`Programming`).

isOwner.description:
`true` if the authenticated athlete owns this workout. `false` if the workout belongs
            to a coach but is included because it is referenced by a scheduled workout assigned to this athlete.
            Non-owned workouts should be treated as read-only on the mobile client.

exercises.description: The exercises that make up this workout. Always present; may be empty for soft-deleted records.

createdAt.description: The UTC timestamp when this workout was first created.

updatedAt.description:
The UTC timestamp of the most recent server-side modification. Used by the mobile client as the
`since` cursor for subsequent delta pulls.

isDeleted.description:
`true` if this workout has been soft-deleted. The mobile client must remove this record
            from its local store when this field is `true`.

isArchived.description:
`true` if this workout is archived. Archived workouts are excluded from default
            library queries (`GET /api/gyms/{gymId}/workouts`) but continue to flow through
            delta sync as live rows so the mobile client can render the workout name and exercises
            on completed scheduled-workout history. The local sync layer should retain archived
            rows in its cache regardless of how list views filter them.

WorkoutResponse.description:
Represents a workout record returned by the delta pull endpoint. Includes soft-deleted records so the
mobile client can remove them from its local store.

items.description: The items returned for the current page.

page.description: The current 1-based page number that was returned.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of items per page as requested.

totalCount.description: The total number of items matching the query across all pages.

totalPages.description:
The total number of pages available given FitEpic.Api.Models.Response.PagedResponse`1.TotalCount and FitEpic.Api.Models.Response.PagedResponse`1.PageSize.
The mobile client should continue requesting incrementing pages until FitEpic.Api.Models.Response.PagedResponse`1.Page equals FitEpic.Api.Models.Response.PagedResponse`1.TotalPages.

WorkoutResponsePagedResponse.description:
A paginated response wrapper returned by Delta Pull endpoints.
The mobile client uses FitEpic.Api.Models.Response.PagedResponse`1.Page, FitEpic.Api.Models.Response.PagedResponse`1.PageSize, and FitEpic.Api.Models.Response.PagedResponse`1.TotalPages
to loop through all pages during an initial bootstrap sync or subsequent delta pulls.
